summary: 16-year-old girl fell into a crevice on Horsetooth Rock around 7:30 a.m. Monday, breaking an ankle; she spent about 3 hours in the crevice, conscious and talking to rescuers; 40+ responders extracted her and took turns carrying her stretcher to a waiting medical helicopter
location: Horsetooth Rock, Horsetooth Mountain Open Space, west of Fort Collins
responding_agency: Poudre Fire Authority; Larimer County Search and Rescue volunteers
notes: CPR 2014-08-18; date weekday-verified Monday; 2.5-mi trail with rock scrambling near summit
